editorial_thesis: A scientific representation adequate for one ecological task may cease to be reusable after capability, future grammar, structural replacement, mechanism responsibility, evidence, target, representation, or domain changes.
claim_ceiling: This workspace coordinates writing; it does not transfer theorem, code, data, or evidence ownership to theouni.
Chapter briefs may summarize source-owned results but may not strengthen their claim ceilings.
TU-2, TU-3, and TU-4 are embedded bridge/firewall modules, not independent novelty chapters.
TU-1 remains a synthesis result unless a distinct carrier-changing revision theorem is established.
No empirical state claim is licensed without the Reality-to-Theory admission bridge.

units.title: The Reuse Problem in Ecology
units.headline_result: The dissertation studies when a state, law, measurement, causal result, or warning may be reused beyond the ecological task for which it was built.
units.forbidden_inference: a representation that worked once => a representation that is reusable for every later scientific responsibility

units.title: When Conservation Capacity Outgrows Conservation Knowledge
units.headline_result: For every m >= 1, one new controllable action can add exactly one viable world while forcing a retained present slice to refine from one state to 2^m states, creating exactly m bits of monitoring debt under unchanged evidence.
units.forbidden_inference: small intervention or capability gain => small required-state or monitoring burden

units.title: When Closed Simplicity Fails under Open Futures
units.headline_result: Constant-sized exact interfaces under fixed closed response grammars can require exponentially more states, or m additional bits, after the legal future grammar is opened.
units.forbidden_inference: simple exact interfaces under each closed grammar => a simple exact interface under the open grammar

units.title: When Macro-Laws Do Not Survive Ecological Replacement
units.headline_result: An inherited source macro-law transports only under explicit source-target coherence; failure admits a unique coarsest source-relative repair, transport defect, and minimal history augmentation.
units.forbidden_inference: an exact source macro-law => the same exact macro-law after turnover, recolonization, extinction, or rewiring

units.title: When Visible Equivalence Fails under Mechanism Uncertainty
units.headline_result: A candidate-independent deterministic law exists exactly when retained mechanism response types agree; otherwise honest reporting must remain typed or set-valued.
units.forbidden_inference: same visible state => same deterministic intervention law

units.title: When Evidence Does Not License the State We Need
units.headline_result: Experiment records induce compatible-world classes; deterministic reporting is justified only when the target is constant on the compatible class and the observation architecture reliably supports the credited split.
units.forbidden_inference: more, finer, or nominally distinguishing information => a licensed ecological target

units.title: When Learning the Cause and Licensing the Decision Diverge
units.headline_result: RACH preserves all admissible causal programmes and selects next observations by validated learning value, while TU-2 shows that causal-learning value and target-licensing status can vary independently and reverse experiment rankings.
units.forbidden_inference: pattern fit or high causal-learning value => identified cause or licensed decision target

units.title: Which State Actually Generates Functional Loss?
units.headline_result: The complete simulator state is sufficient under the declared closure, but matching common eco-genetic marginals can hide transition-relevant spatial alignment; TU-3 separates raw representation from the loss-generating quotient.
units.forbidden_inference: raw simulator detail or matching coarse eco-genetic marginals => the correct loss-generating state

units.title: When an Early Signal Is Not a Warning
units.headline_result: Baseline-relative genetic erosion preceded loss in all inherited and fresh event trajectories, yet the same thresholds fired in all audited non-event trajectories, producing zero specificity and AUC 0.5; warning validity and portability therefore require a finer audit than temporal precedence.
units.forbidden_inference: signal precedes loss => the signal is a valid or portable warning

units.title: The Theory Universe: Adequacy Has No Privileged Direction of Travel
units.headline_result: A revised state Q is recoverable from an old stored state P exactly when q_Q factors through q_P; otherwise exact same-carrier revision debt quantifies what the earlier compression erased.
units.forbidden_inference: a representation adequate for the original task => a representation revisable for a later task

hard_dependencies.relation: loss domain must be fixed warning-blind before warning evaluation
